faq.title: AJ 126 Engine FAQs
faq.description: Answers about pricing, warranty, engine codes and fitting for the supercharged Jaguar XJ AJ 126 engine.

faqs.q: How much is a Jaguar XJ AJ 126 engine replacement?
faqs.a: It depends on whether you choose a used, reconditioned or rebuilt engine and whether we fit it. Send your registration and we'll provide an itemised written quote.

faqs.q: Do your AJ 126 engines come with a warranty?
faqs.a: Yes. Every engine we supply includes a six-month mechanical warranty. We'll explain exactly what's covered and any conditions, including those for outside fitting, before you order.

faqs.q: Are AJ 126 and 306PS the same engine?
faqs.a: Yes. AJ 126 is the engineering name for the supercharged 3.0 V6, while 306PS is the code typically used in parts catalogues. We confirm your exact version from the VIN.

faqs.q: Was the AJ 126 fitted to a 1996 XJ?
faqs.a: No. The 1996 XJ used six-cylinder and V12 engines. The AJ 126 is listed for the X351 XJ, so we always check your engine code before supplying anything.

faqs.q: What are common Jaguar XJ AJ 126 engine problems?
faqs.a: Reported issues include water pump and coolant leaks, thermostat housing faults, timing chain tensioner wear and supercharger isolator noise. Symptoms overlap, so diagnosis should come before any repair decision.

faqs.q: Can you deliver an AJ 126 to my garage?
faqs.a: Yes. Supply-only engines are delivered by pallet across the UK, to homes or independent garages. We confirm compatibility before dispatch and explain warranty conditions for third-party fitting.

faqs.q: What does your AJ 126 supply and fit service include?
faqs.a: At our Grays, Essex workshop we remove the failed engine, install the replacement, refill fluids, complete software setup and road test your XJ. Timescales are confirmed with your quote.

If overheating or chain failure has caused internal damage, compare the repair estimate with your XJ's mileage and value.
paragraphs: The Jaguar XJ AJ 126 engine replacement cost depends on the engine type, its condition and whether fitting is included. Removing a supercharged V6 from a large saloon takes considerable labour, so full supply and fit quotes allow the fairest comparison.

When reviewing AJ 126 3.0 V6 supercharged petrol engine UK listings, ask which model and drivetrain the engine came from. Confirm mileage, history and pre-sale checks so you can judge its true value with confidence.

Warranty cover matters too. A Jaguar XJ AJ 126 engine with warranty protects you if a mechanical fault develops after installation. Engines we supply include a six-month mechanical warranty, and we explain the terms before you place an order.

engineProblems.title: Jaguar XJ AJ 126 Engine Problems to Recognise
engineProblems.description: These signs may indicate a fault; a proper diagnosis confirms the cause.

cards.title: Water Pump Leaks
cards.description: Coolant traces near the front of the engine or a falling reservoir level may suggest a failing water pump.
cards.action: Book a cooling system inspection soon.

cards.title: Overheating Warnings
cards.description: A high temperature reading or warning message could relate to coolant loss, thermostat housing faults or a split coolant pipe.
cards.action: Stop driving and request a pressure test.

cards.title: Rattle After Cold Start
cards.description: A short rattle as the engine fires from cold might indicate wear in the timing chain tensioners or guides.
cards.action: Have the timing chains inspected promptly.

cards.title: Chattering at Tickover
cards.description: A chatter or knock at idle that quietens with revs may point to a worn supercharger drive isolator.
cards.action: Ask for a supercharger drive check.

cards.title: Loss of Power
cards.description: Flat performance or limp mode might relate to the charge cooler pump, a boost leak or sensor problems.
cards.action: Book a boost and cooling test.

cards.title: Rough Running
cards.description: An uneven idle, misfire or flashing engine light could stem from ignition coils, spark plugs or injector faults.

engineOverview.title: Understanding the Supercharged 3.0 V6 in Your XJ
paragraphs: AJ 126 is Jaguar Land Rover's own name for its 2,995cc supercharged V6 petrol engine, usually coded 306PS in parts catalogues. In the X351 XJ it is listed as the 3.0 SCV6, rated at 340PS or 250kW, with both rear-wheel-drive and all-wheel-drive versions also available.

That 340PS rating is why owners search for a Jaguar XJ 3.0 V6 supercharged petrol engine 340hp. The engine was developed from Jaguar's 5.0 V8 family and uses direct injection, chain-driven camshafts and a belt-driven supercharger mounted in the valley.

A Jaguar XJ AJ 126 engine 1996 search won't match any car, because the XJ of that year used six-cylinder and V12 engines. The AJ 126 belongs to the later X351 generation, so we confirm generation, drivetrain and engine code before quoting.
